# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest  | ✅        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report privately through this repository's **Security → Advisories → New draft
security advisory** page, or email the maintainer directly.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and ship a fix within 14 days for confirmed vulnerabilities.

## Disclosure policy

We follow [coordinated disclosure](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_vulnerability_disclosure):

1. Reporter notifies us privately.
2. We confirm and triage within 48 h.
3. We patch + notify reporter.
4. Public disclosure after patch ships (or 90 days, whichever comes first).

## Scope

This app is built on [golusoris/golusoris](https://github.com/golusoris/golusoris).
Vulnerabilities in the framework itself should also be reported to that repository.

## Compliance

Using golusoris does not certify this application. Document applicable
requirements, control mappings, tests, and retained evidence here.
